method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across being seen, known and drawn near, grace already received, turning throughout the day, the language of longing, desire and the will of God, what hinders nearness, recognition and the limits of knowledge, the door of bounty, presence, journeys and acceptance, prayer that includes others, sorrow and the life to come, nearness in every world, and the fruits of nearness in service. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: O Generous One! Leave not this servant to himself
selected.reason: Brief plea of Bahá’u’lláh that the Generous One leave not this servant to himself; keeps the opening reminder that the journey toward nearness is not self-sufficient.

selected.text: O Lord! Open before my face the doors of Thy grace and bounty
selected.reason: Brief prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the doors of grace and bounty be opened before the supplicant’s face; carries the door image of the introduction.

selected.text: Grant us a shelter in Thy threshold and inform us of Thy mysteries!
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in the plural for shelter at God’s threshold and knowledge of His mysteries.

selected.text: O God! Suffer these wanderers around thy abode to become Thy passionate lovers
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that these wanderers around God’s abode become His passionate lovers.

selected.text: O Lord! Ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee in all conditions.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will draw the supplicant nigh in all conditions; the recurring request in its simplest form.

selected.text: Confer upon this indigent one an abode in the Neighborhood of Thy Infinite Mercy.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to Mrs Cruttwell asking an abode for this indigent one in the neighborhood of infinite mercy.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to accept from us what we have wrought in Thy love and good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that what we have wrought in God’s love be accepted.

selected.text: and will draw them nigh unto Thee in the life that now is and the life that is to come.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O God! Thou art the Companion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of the Báb addressing God as the Companion of the heavens and the earth and all between them.

selected.text: Then ordain for every soul that which will draw him nigh unto Thee in this world and the next
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that every soul be given what draws it nigh in this world and the next; the guide’s closing widening of the prayer.

selected.text: O Lord! Raise me up unto Thee, shelter me in Thy nearness, and aid me through Thy grace and bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to be raised up and sheltered in God’s nearness.

selected.text: We beseech Thee not to withhold us for less than the twinkling of an eye from Thy Most Great Horizon
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be withheld for less than the twinkling of an eye from the Most Great Horizon; a memorable measure of constant turning.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou knowest that separation from Thee hath consumed me and remoteness from Thee hath destroyed me.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that separation has consumed and remoteness destroyed the supplicant; distills the language of longing.

selected.text: O my Lord! Ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and will be with me in every world of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will draw nigh and remain with the supplicant in every world of God’s worlds.

selected.text: And unto Thee be glory and favor, for having caused me to dwell near unto Thee and having made me to hear Thy call.
selected.reason: Short thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for having been caused to dwell near unto God and to hear His call; a concise statement of nearness received.

selected.text: Then write down, O my God, for me and for her that which will draw us near unto Thee and cause us to speak Thy praise
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for the supplicant and for her, that both be drawn near and speak His praise.

selected.text: Hear thou the Call from the Most Glorious Horizon - verily it will draw thee nigh unto a station sublime and wondrous
selected.reason: Call of Bahá’u’lláh to hear the Call from the Most Glorious Horizon, which will draw the hearer nigh unto a sublime station.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to make me, under all conditions, to fix my gaze upon Thee and to be detached from all else besides Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to fix the gaze upon God under all conditions and be detached from all else.

selected.text: O Lord! My thirst entitles me to the Kawthar of Thy presence, and the fire of my love seeks the wine of union with Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that thirst entitles the supplicant to the Kawthar of presence and love’s fire seeks the wine of union; a striking reversal of need into claim.

selected.text: Cast me not from Thy presence, O my Lord, neither do Thou drive me away from the shores of Thy love and Thy good-pleasure
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou beholdest me oppressed among the wayward ones of Thy creation, and a stranger in Thy realm.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one oppressed among the wayward and a stranger in God’s realm; names an outward obstacle to nearness.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest me advancing towards Thy most exalted horizon and clinging to the cord of Thy bounty, O Thou Lord of all names!
selected.reason: Short prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one advancing toward the most exalted horizon and clinging to the cord of bounty.

selected.text: O Lord! Bestow upon me and upon them that love me that which will draw us nigh unto Thee and remove us far from all else except Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for the supplicant and those who love him, that both be drawn nigh; widens the request to those close at hand.

selected.text: I beseech Thee not to leave me to myself, then make me among those who soar in the atmosphere of Thy love with the wings of certitude
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be left to oneself but to soar in the atmosphere of God’s love with the wings of certitude; answers the earlier broken wings.

selected.text: I ask Thee to draw me ever nearer unto Thy horizon; ordain then for me, O my God, that which shall profit me in every world of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be drawn ever nearer to God’s horizon and given what profits in every world.

selected.text: Draw them nearer, O my God, unto the scene of Thine effulgent glory, and enrapture their hearts with the sweet savors of Thine inspiration
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I desire from Thee naught except that which will strengthen me to remember Thee and praise Thee in Thy land, and to stand firm in Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh desiring naught but strength to remember and praise God and stand firm in His Cause.

selected.text: O Lord! Hasten the day of my arrival unto Thee and my entrance into the court of Thy holiness. Verily, Thou art the Gracious, the Most High.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to hasten the day of his arrival unto God and entrance into the court of holiness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to cause me to be immersed in the ocean of Thy oneness and to stand before the door of Thy bounty in every world of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be immersed in the ocean of oneness and stand before the door of bounty in every world.

selected.text: O thou who art turning unto God! Turn to the Abha Kingdom and seek assistance from the Concourse on High. Then loose thy tongue in supplication
selected.reason: Counsel of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to turn to the Abhá Kingdom, seek assistance from the Concourse on High and loose the tongue in supplication; opens the movement into thanksgiving.

selected.text: Free us from the greatest abasement in this world and the next, and make us successful in achieving spiritual glory and nobility in both worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in the plural for freedom from abasement and success in spiritual glory in both worlds.

selected.text: O my God! Drive not this poor one from the door of Thy riches, and remove not this handmaiden from the paradise of Thy nearness and Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a handmaiden not to be driven from the door of riches nor removed from the paradise of nearness.

selected.text: O my Lord! Send down upon me from the clouds of Thy mercy that which will sever me from all else save Thee and draw me nigh unto meeting with Thee
selected.reason: Short prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for mercy that severs from all else and draws the supplicant nigh unto meeting with God.

selected.text: Poor and desolate I am, O my Lord! Immerse me in the ocean of Thy wealth; athirst, suffer me to drink from the living waters of Thy loving-kindness.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee … to draw me and those who have believed near unto Thy most exalted horizon and the manifestation of Thy most resplendent Beauty
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to draw the supplicant and those who have believed near to the most exalted horizon.

selected.text: O my God, my God! I have turned toward Thee and directed myself to the ocean of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy bestowals and the dayspring of Thy grace.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh declaring that the supplicant has turned toward the ocean of bounty, the heaven of bestowals and the dayspring of grace; a simple act of orientation.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by this very Name not to suffer me to be far from the court of Thy holiness, nor debarred from the exalted sanctuary of Thy unity and oneness.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I implore Thee … to grant that I may, at all times, be wholly dissolved in Thee, and fix my gaze upon the horizon of Thy will and be steadfast in Thy love
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Take hold of these decaying bones, this ailing body, this wasting frame, and this empty shell, raise me up unto Thee and bring me into Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that decaying bones and an ailing body be raised and brought into God’s presence; keeps the setting of severe suffering.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … that Thou change the fire of separation from Thy loved ones into the light of reunion with Thee, and their remoteness into nearness unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the fire of separation of His loved ones be changed into the light of reunion and their remoteness into nearness.

selected.text: In truth, the desire of heart and soul is presence at the Threshold, that face and hair may become perfumed and fragrant with the dust of the Sacred Threshold
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the desire of heart and soul is presence at the Sacred Threshold; gives longing a concrete place.

selected.text: Open before the faces of Thy servants the gate which was closed … that through it may enter those who desire to attain the presence of the throne of Thy grandeur
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the closed gate be opened so those who desire His presence may enter; opens the prayers concerning journeys and arrival.

selected.text: Turn to the Kingdom of Abha and take hold of the Sure Handle. Fix thy gaze upon the Most Exalted Horizon and place thy trust in the Lord of the first and the last
selected.reason: Counsel of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to turn to the Kingdom of Abhá, take hold of the Sure Handle, fix the gaze on the Most Exalted Horizon and trust in the Lord.

selected.text: Decree for me, by Thy Bounty, O Lord, that which shall prosper me in this world and hereafter and shall draw me nigh unto Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all men.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy most sweet utterance and the Manifestations of Thy Cause in the kingdom of creation to aid me in that which Thou lovest and art pleased with.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for aid in whatever God loves and is pleased with; a brief statement of desire aligned with divine good-pleasure.

selected.text: My God, my God! Shut me not out from the ocean of Thy bounty, nor from the outpourings of Thy days. Ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be shut out from the ocean of bounty and the outpourings of God’s days.

selected.text: O Lord of all worlds! Cause me to burn with the fire of Thy love in this world, and in the next world make me successful through beholding Thy moon-like countenance.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to burn with love in this world and behold God’s countenance in the next.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … that Thou mayest open, through the key of Thy craftsmanship, unto every atom a door leading to Thy presence and a way unto the ocean of Thy reunion
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that God open to every atom a door to His presence; the closing image of renewed attention to the world.

selected.text: for Thy beauty, to ordain for Thy loved ones that which shall draw them nigh unto the ocean whereof if one partaketh, no grief shall touch him in Thy Cause, nor shall any worldly concerns trouble him in his love and contentment with Thee. I beseech Thee, O my Lord
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that His loved ones be drawn to the ocean whereof whoever partakes is untouched by grief in His Cause.

selected.text: O my Lord! Ordain for us from the wonders of Thy bounty that which will draw us nigh unto Thee, then write down for us the good of this world and of the world to come.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh in the plural for what will draw us nigh and the good of this world and the next.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest this evanescent one seeking the Kawthar of Thy perpetual grace from the hands of Thy bounty, and this weary one seeking the kingdom of Thine utterance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of an evanescent and weary one seeking the Kawthar of perpetual grace and the kingdom of utterance.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Lord of all names and Creator of the heavens, to make me as one of the fish in the ocean of Thy oneness, that I may swim therein by Thy leave and will
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be made one of the fish in the ocean of divine oneness, swimming by God’s leave and will; answers the thirsty fish with an image of surrender.

selected.text: My God, my God! Aid me with a penetrating heavenly power in my pillars, members, parts, nerves, veins and arteries until I am filled with the breaths of Thy holy spirit
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for heavenly power in every member, nerve, vein and artery until filled with the breaths of the holy spirit; a vivid bodily image.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy most beautiful names to send down for me from the heaven of Thy mercy that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and preserve me from all else beside Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by God’s most beautiful names for what will draw nigh and preserve from all else.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the mysteries of Thy Cause to ordain for me the reward of meeting Thee and of attaining unto presence before Thy throne.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for the reward of meeting and of attaining presence before His throne.

selected.text: Therefore, with complete attraction turn thy face unto the Realm on high and fervently supplicate unto the Lord, perchance His grace and limitless favours may encompass thee
selected.reason: Counsel of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to turn with complete attraction to the Realm on high and fervently supplicate, perchance grace may encompass the recipient; frames turning as an act of prayer.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest the drop seeking the ocean of Thy grace and the sea of Thy bounty, and the atom seeking the effulgences of the sun of Thy generosity and munificence
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of the drop seeking the ocean and the atom seeking the sun of generosity; images of smallness before abundance.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the outpourings of Thy days and the breathings of Thy Revelation to ordain for me that which shall be a lamp before my face in all the worlds of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will be a lamp before the supplicant’s face in all God’s worlds.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Refuge of existence and Lord of the unseen and the seen, to ordain for me through the pen of Thy grace that which will honor me with meeting Thee once again.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will honor the supplicant with meeting Him once again.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to let Thy remembrance be my companion, and Thy love my aim, and Thy face my goal, and Thy name my lamp, and Thy wish my desire, and Thy pleasure my delight
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to ordain for me that which shall make me independent of all else save Thee and detached from whatsoever hath prevented Thy servants from drawing nigh unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for independence of all else and detachment from what prevents servants from drawing nigh.

selected.text: I call upon Thee at this moment when I have detached myself from all that hath been created between earth and heaven, and have turned my face toward Thy Most Exalted Countenance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh calling upon God at a moment of detachment from all between earth and heaven, with the face turned toward His Countenance.

selected.text: O Lord! I am she who hath taken refuge with Thee and hastened unto Thee, detached from all else beside Thee … Grant me reunion with Thee, then sever me from all else save Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh in a woman’s voice of one who has taken refuge with God, asking reunion and then severance from all else.

selected.text: Grant that I may reap the benefit of my life in this world and in the next. Open to my face the portals of Thy grace and graciously confer upon me Thy tender mercy and bestowals.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I find myself now in the vicinity of Thy great mercy, beneath the shadow of Thy Most Exalted Name, and seated before the kindled lamp of Thy grace within the niche of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one who finds himself in the vicinity of God’s mercy, before the kindled lamp of grace in the niche of bounty.

selected.text: Wouldst Thou, O my God, deprive him who hath turned toward the sanctuary of Thy Being? Wouldst Thou, O my Beloved, cast away him who hath sought refuge in the city of Thy nearness?
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking whether God would cast away one who has sought refuge in the city of His nearness.

selected.text: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance that Thou withhold me not from the fountain of Thy good-pleasure, nor distance me from nearness to Thee and Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be withheld from the fountain of good-pleasure nor distanced from nearness and presence.

selected.text: I implore Thee, by Thy divine sweetness and by the splendors of the glory of Thy face, to send down upon us from Thy retreats on high that which will enable us to draw nigh unto Thee
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Deny me not, O my Lord, the fragrances of Thy raiment in Thy days, and deprive me not of the breathings of Thy Revelation at the appearance of the splendors of the light of Thy face
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Therefore, O my God, I, one of Thy handmaidens, have desired nearness unto Thee and reunion with Thee and to enter the sanctuary of Thy mighty oneness and to stand before Thy throne.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh in a handmaiden’s voice desiring nearness, reunion and to stand before His throne.

selected.text: cause him to enter Thy Garden of Eden, shelter him beneath Thy Lote-Tree of the Extremity, house him in Thy Paradise of Refuge, grant him the meeting with Thee in Thy highest Paradise
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a departed soul to enter the Garden, be sheltered beneath the Lote-Tree and granted meeting in the highest Paradise.

selected.text: Draw nigh, O my God, unto them that desire Thy reunion and presence, then cause them to enter the precincts of Thy mercy. O Lord! Deprive them not of the fragrant breezes of Thy nearness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking God Himself to draw nigh to those who desire reunion and not deprive them of the breezes of nearness.

selected.text: My God, my God! Nearness to Thee is my life, and Thy presence is the ultimate object of my hope … I beseech Thee to ordain for me that which will preserve me and draw me nigh unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh declaring nearness to God the supplicant’s life and His presence the object of hope.

selected.text: Cause me to soar, O my Beloved, in the atmosphere of Thy nearness and the heaven of Thy reunion, that I may thank Thee among Thy handmaidens and make mention of Thee amidst Thy creation.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to soar in the atmosphere of nearness and reunion, giving thanks among the handmaidens.

selected.text: In separation from You they have rent their collars, and in deprivation they have tasted the poison of severance. Night and day they weep for You, and day and night they lament toward You.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing those who in separation have rent their collars and weep night and day; shows longing as a shared lament.

selected.text: By Thy glory and Thy sovereignty, let not the vicissitudes of the world prevent me from drawing nigh unto Thee, nor its hardships from gazing toward the horizon of the heaven of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the vicissitudes and hardships of the world not prevent drawing nigh to God.

selected.text: I know not, O my God, how to praise Thee that my heart might be emptied of the might of Thy justice and my outward state might be gladdened by witnessing the beauty of attaining unto Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb confessing not knowing how to praise God so that the heart might be gladdened by attaining unto Him.

selected.text: access to this servant of Thy threshold unto the court of Thy oneness, and let not this one who hopes in Thy mercy be disappointed. Make him firm and steadfast in the Covenant and in faith
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for access to the court of oneness and to be made firm and steadfast in the Covenant.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou art witness and aware that I entertain no hope in my heart and soul but Thy good pleasure, and seek no path or comfort other than acceptance in the assemblage of the Covenant.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring no hope but God’s good pleasure and no path but acceptance in the assemblage of the Covenant.

selected.text: O Lord! I have turned toward the City of Thy nearness and directed my face unto Thy countenance. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me from the ocean of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy generosity.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one turned toward the City of nearness, asking not to be disappointed of the ocean of bounty.

selected.text: O God of existence and Sovereign of the seen and unseen! I beseech Thee to make me hear, in all conditions, Thy most sweet call and to draw me nigh unto Thee through Thy bountiful grace.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to hear God’s most sweet call in all conditions and be drawn nigh by His grace.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having guided Thy servant unto Thy straight path and ordained for him that which drew him nigh unto Thee in days wherein the limbs of the idolaters trembled.
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for guidance that drew the servant nigh in days when the limbs of the idolaters trembled; sets gratitude within a time of upheaval.

selected.text: Suffer him to attain Thy presence and to enjoy reunion with Thee in Thy most exalted dominion and Thy most glorious kingdom and make him Thine most august companion through Thy loving-kindness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a soul attain God’s presence and reunion in His most exalted dominion.

selected.text: Send down upon her from the clouds of Thy grace and the heaven of Thy generosity that which shall draw her near unto Thee in all conditions and cause her to speak of Thy remembrance and praise.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a woman, that what draws her near in all conditions be sent down and she speak His praise.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst create the world and subdue the nations to render me detached from all else save Thee and to enable me to hold fast to the cord of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be made detached from all else and to hold fast to the cord of bounty.

selected.text: Open Thou mine eyes to behold the lights of Thy countenance and mine ears to hearken unto the cooing of the Dove of Thy Cause. Then loose Thou my tongue to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that eyes be opened to the lights of God’s countenance, ears to the Dove of His Cause and tongue loosed in His praise.

selected.text: By the holy fragrances is my heart quickened, and through the attractions of Thy beauty of oneness is my heart enraptured … Through the manifestations of Thy Kingdom of mercy is my essence revived
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá whose heart is quickened by holy fragrances and enraptured by the beauty of oneness; opens the fruits of nearness.

selected.text: O Lord! I sense the fragrance of Thy manifestation but know not which place is illumined by the light of Thy knowledge and adorned with the splendors of Thy countenance and honored by Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh sensing the fragrance of the manifestation but not knowing which place is honored by His presence.

selected.text: My heart has melted from separation and remoteness from Thee, and my joints have trembled in my distance from the court of Thy nearness. I know not, O my God, by what deed I may draw nigh unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh whose heart has melted in separation, confessing “I know not … by what deed I may draw nigh unto Thee”; joins longing to uncertainty.

selected.text: O Lord! How long shall this deprivation last and how long this separation continue? Let me attain the cup of forgiveness and give me to drink from the spring of life. Verily You are the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking how long deprivation and separation shall last and seeking the cup of forgiveness and the spring of life.

selected.text: Thou beareth witness, O my God, that I desire to behold Thy lights and long to apprehend Thy mysteries. Make me weary of foreignness, acquaint me with union, and suffer me to attain my heart's desire.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá longing to behold divine lights and apprehend mysteries, asking to be made weary of foreignness and acquainted with union.

selected.text: O God, my God! Thou seest me, Thou knowest me; Thou art my Haven and my Refuge. None have I sought nor any will I seek save Thee; no path have I trodden nor any will I tread but the path of Thy love.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I beg of Thee, by the beauty of Thy countenance, to make my remoteness from home a means whereby Thy servants may be drawn nigh unto the Fountain-head of Thy Cause and the Dayspring of Thy Revelation
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to assist me in Thy love and good-pleasure and in serving Thy Cause in Thy days. Then ordain for me, O my God, that which is best for me and draw me nigh unto Thee under all conditions.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for aid in love, good-pleasure and serving the Cause, and for nearness in all conditions.

selected.text: I find no path except toward Thee and no refuge save in Thee. I beseech Thee … that Thou cast me not out from the court of Thy mercy nor prevent me from arriving at the shore of the sea of Thy oneness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh finding no path but toward God and no refuge save in Him, asking not to be cast out from His mercy.

selected.text: All praise be unto Thee, O Thou besides Whom there is none other God. Graciously enable me to ascend unto Thee, to be granted the honor of dwelling in Thy nearness and to have communion with Thee alone
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: that I may enter the kingdom of Thy generosity and the dominion of Thy favors, and hearken unto the wondrous melodies of Thy voice, and behold with mine eyes the splendors of the light of Thy countenance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to hearken to the melodies of God’s voice and behold with the eyes the light of His countenance; joins hearing and sight.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am a leaf among the leaves of the Tree of Thy Cause, which the winds of Thy will and the breezes of Thy revelation have stirred. I beseech Thee not to deprive me from the ocean of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of a leaf on the Tree of His Cause stirred by the winds of His will; the leaf image the introduction names.

selected.text: Then cause us to witness in all things the signs of Thy Lordship and the lights of Thine eternity, that through Thy power we may gather upon the carpet of Thy oneness and in the places of Thy glorification.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that we witness in all things the signs of God’s Lordship and gather on the carpet of His oneness.

selected.text: Send down, therefore, from the heaven of Thy will that which will purify us from the world and its conditions, and adorn us with the ornament of what Thou hast desired for us through Thy grace and bestowal.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Oh, how I long to depart from this evanescent abode for the precincts of Thy most great mercy, to sever the cord of my attachment to this world, and to hold fast and cleave unto the threshold of Thy holiness
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá longing to depart this evanescent abode for the precincts of God’s mercy.

selected.text: O my Lord! Leave me not to myself and my desires, then send down upon me from the cloud of Thy mercy that which shall purify me from the mention of aught else but Thee. Then assign me a seat of truth with Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be left to oneself and one’s desires, but purified by mercy from mention of aught else; opens the requests for purification.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou art my hope and the ultimate goal of my aspirations. I beseech Thee … to assist this servant of Thine in his servitude at Thy merciful threshold and his bondage at the court of Thy divine holiness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for aid to this servant in servitude at God’s merciful threshold.

selected.text: My Lord, separation from Thee hath destroyed me, parting from Thee hath burned me, and absence from Thee hath killed me. I beseech Thee by the light of Thy reunion to ordain for Thy servant to attain Thy presence
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that separation, parting and absence have destroyed, burned and killed the supplicant, asking by the light of reunion to attain His presence.

selected.text: My Lord! My Lord! This is Thy sorrowing servant - gladden him with the signs of Thy bounties in this witnessed Day, and make him joyous through the grace of the Ancient Beauty and the generosity of Thy Great Name.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a sorrowing servant be gladdened with signs of divine bounty.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Most Exalted Self and by Thy Most Glorious Name, to draw Thy servants nigh unto the shore of the ocean of Thy oneness. O my Lord! Disappoint them not of that which lieth with Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that His servants be drawn to the shore of the ocean of His oneness.

selected.text: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Light and Thy Mighty Announcement to open before my face the door of Thy mercy and Thy grace, then ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones and trusted ones.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the door of mercy and grace be opened before the supplicant’s face.

selected.text: O Thou Kind Beloved! I am thirsty for the water of Thy Bestowal! Grant me a chalice from the fountain of Thy love! I am longing for the appearance of Thy lights, reveal unto me the splendors of the Sun of Thy Reality!
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá thirsting for the water of bestowal and longing for the lights of the Sun of Reality.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Beloved of the world and Desire of the nations, Who hath appeared with the Most Great Name, that Thou disappoint me not from the rain-showers of the clouds of Thy grace and aid me to serve Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for the rain-showers of grace and aid to serve His Cause.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the Staff which vanquished the swords, to make me gaze toward Thee, turn toward the lights of Thy countenance, hold fast to Thy cord, and cling to the hem of the robe of Thy grace
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by the Staff which vanquished the swords, to gaze toward God and hold fast to His cord.

selected.text: O Lord! Plunge him into the pools of everlasting life and cause him to warble with the melody of the Dove in the gardens of faithfulness, that he may roar with the roaring of a lion in the thickets of Thy greatest bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a believer be plunged in the pools of everlasting life and roar like a lion in the thickets of bounty; a vivid image of transformation.

selected.text: O Self-Sufficing Lord! Make these hearts intimate with Your mystery and free them from stranger and kin alike. Give them to drink from the morning cup in the dawn of oneness and intoxicate them with the cup of "Am I not?"
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that these hearts be made intimate with God’s mystery and given the morning cup and the cup of “Am I not?”.

selected.text: My God, my God! The thirst of my heart has consumed me - where is the river of Thy mercy, O God of the worlds? Thy decree and destiny have removed me far - where is the light of Thy nearness, O Goal of them that know Thee?
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking where the river of mercy and the light of nearness are when thirst and decree have removed the supplicant far.

selected.text: O Lord! Assist us in Thy service, and enable us to serve at Thy threshold, and grant us the fruits of the tree of Thy knowledge, and admit us into the garden of Thy gift, and cause us to abide in the paradise of Thy oneness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in the plural for aid in service at God’s threshold and the fruits of the tree of knowledge.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my Lord, the All-Merciful! I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Book and the lights of Thy Throne to open before my face, through the key of Thy Most Great Name, the door of Thy nearness and meeting.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the door of nearness and meeting be opened through the key of the Most Great Name; the guide’s clearest prayer at the door.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Lord of Eternity and Sovereign of the nations, to ordain for me through Thy bounty that which shall keep me from aught else save Thee and draw me nigh in all conditions unto the ocean of Thy good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what keeps the supplicant from all else and draws him in all conditions to the ocean of God’s good-pleasure.

selected.text: there is no healing for mine ills nor is there a quenching for my thirst save to perish in the deserts of separation while consumed with the fire of longing. Aid me, O Thou Beloved of the world, by Thy generosity and grace
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá confessing there is no quenching for thirst save to perish in the deserts of separation, consumed with longing, and asking for aid.

selected.text: This is a Day wherein every friend crieth out "Have mercy upon me, O Thou Most Merciful One!" and every chosen one cleaveth to the hem of grace, saying "O Lord of all nations! Cause me then to enter among Thy sincere servants
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh describing a Day in which every friend cries for mercy and every chosen one clings to the hem of grace.

selected.text: I know not, O my God and my Master and my heart's Desire, whether Thy grace will bring me nigh unto Thee that I may stand before Thy face and see what Moses desired from the heaven of Thy bounty and the ocean of Thy generosity
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not knowing whether grace will bring the supplicant to stand before His face and see what Moses desired.

selected.text: We are helpless birds with broken wings, yet we desire to soar in the realm of the Kingdom. We are thirsty fish seeking the ocean of the water of life. We are moths of the mortal world yearning for the lamp of the divine realm.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá picturing helpless birds with broken wings, thirsty fish seeking the ocean and moths yearning for the lamp; introduces the images the introduction names.

selected.text: My God, my God! Nearness to Thee is my hope, and to stand before Thy presence is my desire, and to hearken to the flowing of Thy Pen is my wish, and to appear before the throne of Thy justice is the ultimate goal of my purpose.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh naming nearness, standing before the presence, hearing the Pen and appearing before the throne of justice as the goal of hope.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the Word through which the heavens were raised up, the verses were sent down, and the signs appeared, that Thou draw me nigh unto the ocean of Thy knowledge which hath been manifested through one of Thy names.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be drawn nigh unto the ocean of knowledge manifested through one of God’s names.

selected.text: O Lord! They are Thy servants and Thy creation and are in Thy grasp. Deprive them not of the fragrances of Thy days. Ordain for the sincere ones the reward of attaining Thy presence and standing before the gate of Thy grandeur.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for His servants not to be deprived of the fragrances of His days, and for the sincere to receive the reward of presence.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou seest Thy servant clinging to Thy presence, seeking from the wonders of Thy grace that which will draw him nigh unto Thee, honor him with Thy presence, and adorn him with the ornament of Thy loving-kindness.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a servant clinging to His presence, seeking what draws him nigh and adorns him with loving-kindness.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am he who hath turned his face toward Thy countenance and set his face toward the horizon of Thy recognition. Ordain for me that which befitteth Thy generosity and bounty. Verily, Thou art the Bountiful, the Generous.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one who has turned toward God’s countenance and the horizon of recognition, asking for what befits His generosity.

selected.text: My God, my God! I know not in what land Thy call hath been raised … to make me detached from all else but Thee, soaring in the atmosphere of Thy nearness, gazing toward Thy horizon, and drinking the choice wine of Thy utterance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not knowing in what land the call has been raised, asking to soar in the atmosphere of nearness.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest me enkindled with the fire of separation from Thy loved ones. By Thy glory, O Thou Goal of the world and He Who hath appeared through the Most Great Name! I desire none other than Thee and love none but Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one enkindled by separation from God’s loved ones, who desires and loves none other than Him.

selected.text: Although in all times and with the passing of days and ages, hands are raised in prayer and supplication to the court of the Lord, and the tongue is occupied with lamentation and crying and the heart with burning and restlessness
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that through all ages hands are raised in supplication with lamentation and restless hearts; opens the section on sorrow.

selected.text: Withhold not from me, O my Lord, the things Thou didst ordain for such of Thy handmaidens as circle around Thee, and on whom are poured continually the splendors of the sun of Thy beauty and the beams of the brightness of Thy face
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy mysteries that lie concealed within Thy Book and by the splendors of the Day-Star of Thy bounty to ordain for me and for Thy loved ones that which will draw us nigh unto Thee and cause us to speak Thy praise.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for the supplicant and His loved ones, that all be drawn nigh and speak His praise.

selected.text: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having remembered me when I was in the most desolate of lands. I beseech Thee to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and enable me to arise to serve Thee and to serve Thy loved ones
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for remembrance in the most desolate of lands, asking to arise to serve God and His loved ones.

selected.text: O my Most Glorious Lord! Thou seest my abasement and my brokenness, my poverty and my distress. Aid me and aid Thy servant who hath prostrated himself before Thy Beauty, glorified Thy Name, and severed himself from all else but Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking aid for himself and for a servant who has prostrated himself before God’s Beauty.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, by Thine all-glorious Name and by Thy beauty that hath dawned above the horizon of Thy most exalted Essence, to cause me to be related to Thee even as Thou hadst done so aforetime, and not to separate me from Thyself.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Prevailing over all names and the Ruler over all who are in earth and heaven, to make me in all conditions one who circleth round Thy Will and gazeth toward the horizon of Thy Purpose
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to circle round God’s Will and gaze toward the horizon of His Purpose in all conditions.

selected.text: Then cause me to enter, O my God, within the pavilions of Thy nearness and the tabernacle of Thy love. Then unveil unto me, O my God, that which is hidden from the eyes of Thy servants and concealed from the knowledge of Thy creatures.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to enter the pavilions of nearness and have unveiled what is hidden from the eyes of servants.

selected.text: O Lord of Names and Ruler over all things! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the Kingdom was adorned and the Realm of Might was embellished, to aid me to turn toward the Kaaba of Thy Beauty and to stand firm in Thy love and Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for aid to turn toward the Kaaba of His Beauty and stand firm in His love and Cause.

selected.text: we hope that through Thy grace and generosity, Thy favor and bestowal, Thou wilt gather them at the noblest spot in the supreme Kingdom, that all may rest in the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree and attain the blessing of achieving Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá hoping that God will gather them at the noblest spot in the Kingdom, beneath the Lote-Tree, attaining His presence; opens the prayers for others.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Glory at its most glorious to ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones and trusted ones. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful. There is none other God but Thee, the Self-Sufficient, the Most High.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by God’s Glory for what He has ordained for His chosen and trusted ones.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to ordain for me, through Thy bounty and favors, that which will preserve me from all else but Thee, and will render me wholly devoted to Thy remembrance, steadfast in Thy service, and turned in all conditions toward Thy face
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will preserve the supplicant from all else and make him devoted to remembrance and steadfast in service.

selected.text: O Lord! I am a captive - release me through Thy power. I seek refuge - rescue me from the abyss of my deprivation through Thy might. I am a suppliant - shelter me in the cave of Thy protection and care. I am yearning - raise me to Thy Kingdom.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá as captive, refuge-seeker and suppliant asking release, shelter in the cave of protection and ascent to the Kingdom.

selected.text: O my God and my Beloved! The hearts of Thy lovers have melted in their separation from Thee. Where are the waves of the ocean of reunion with Thee? The hearts of those who yearn for Thee are consumed. Where is the path to attaining Thy presence?
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking where the ocean of reunion and the path to presence are for hearts melted in separation.

selected.text: O God of Names and Creator of heaven! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and by the mysteries concealed in Thy knowledge to ordain for me that which will cause me to hold fast to Thy cord and cling to the hem of Thy loving-kindness.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will cause the supplicant to hold fast to God’s cord and cling to the hem of His loving-kindness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to make me in all conditions to turn toward Thy most exalted horizon and to drink from the Kawthar of Thy supreme mercy. O my Lord! Thou seest me turning toward Thy countenance and holding fast to the cord of Thy loving-kindness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to turn toward the most exalted horizon and drink from the Kawthar of supreme mercy.

selected.text: My God, my God! Separation from Thee hath consumed me, and remoteness from Thee hath set me ablaze. Thou seest and knowest that this servant of Thine hath yearned for Thy nearness and Thy will, and his heart hath melted in longing to hear Thy call
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a servant who has yearned for God’s nearness and will and longs to hear His call.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou hearest my cry and beholdest my state. I beseech Thee by Him Who conversed with the Tree, through Whom the Tree of the Manifestation spoke, to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee in every world of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh, by Him Who conversed with the Tree, for what will draw nigh in every world.

selected.text: O my God, my God! The fragrance of Thy knowledge hath attracted me, and the river of Thy utterance hath intoxicated me, to such extent that I have become heedless of myself and of all else besides Thee, and of all who dwell on earth and in heaven.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the fragrance of knowledge and the river of utterance have made the supplicant heedless of himself and all else.

selected.text: O my Lord! Withhold not Thy handmaidens from drawing nigh unto the ocean of Thy utterance and turning towards the horizon of Thy Manifestation. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Generous. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that His handmaidens not be withheld from the ocean of His utterance and the horizon of His Manifestation.

selected.text: Thou hearest my cry, and witnessest my lamentation, and knowest my sighing, and the secret anguish of my heart … How then can I be worthy of the stations of the glory of Thy nearness, or befitting the pavilions of the majesty of meeting with Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that God hears the cry and knows the secret anguish, asking how one could be worthy of the glory of His nearness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge, and by the splendors of the light of the Day-Star of Thy loving kindness, to aid me to remember Thee and to praise Thee, and to turn towards the splendors of the Dawning-place of Thy grace.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for aid to remember and praise God and turn toward the Dawning-place of His grace; places remembrance at the heart of daily turning.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Ka'bih of the lovers and Fire of the hearts of them that are nigh unto Thee, not to render him who hath turned to Thee deprived of what is with Thee and prevented from what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones and Thy messengers.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to the Ka’bih of lovers not to leave one who has turned to Him deprived of what He ordained for His chosen ones.

selected.text: I beseech God to protect you in the proximity of His Most Glorious Kingdom, shelter you beneath the shade of the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, grant you the meeting, and bestow upon you that which you love and with which you are content.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that God protect the recipients in the proximity of His Kingdom and grant them the meeting.

selected.text: Beseech thy Lord at all times that He close not before thy face the gates of the Paradise of His good-pleasure, that thou mayest inhale from it the fragrance of the garment of the remembrance of thy Lord, the Most High, the All-Powerful, the Almighty.
selected.reason: Counsel of Bahá’u’lláh to beseech the Lord at all times that the gates of the Paradise of His good-pleasure not close before one’s face.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy sovereignty which hath encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth, to change the abasement of Thy loved ones into the glory which Thou hast sent down in Thy Tablets. Then gather them together through Thy bounty and favor.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the abasement of His loved ones be changed into glory and that they be gathered together; extends nearness to a community.

selected.text: My Lord! Aid me in that which shall cause my face to shine in the Kingdom of creation, and shall raise me to the Concourse on High, and shall cause me to hear Thy most exalted Word, and shall bring me to the Sadratu'l-Muntaha and the Furthermost Mosque.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for what will cause the face to shine, raise him to the Concourse on High and cause him to hear God’s most exalted Word.

selected.text: I bow my face to the dust of the Threshold of El-Baha and to Him who sitteth on the Throne, I petition as a supplicating captive, begging Him to make thee to behold His Glorious Face and to purify thine insight from aught else save Him among the people.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá petitioning at the Threshold that the recipient behold the Glorious Face and have the insight purified.

selected.text: that Thou leave me not among Thy creatures, but raise me up unto Thee and cause me to enter beneath the shadow of Thy mercy and give me to drink of the pure wine of Thy bounty, that I may dwell in the pavilion of Thy glory and the canopies of Thy favors.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be raised beneath the shadow of mercy and dwell in the pavilion of God’s glory.

selected.text: O Thou Whose nearness is my wish, Whose presence is my hope, Whose remembrance is my desire, Whose court of glory is my goal, Whose abode is my aim, Whose name is my healing, Whose love is the radiance of my heart, Whose service is my highest aspiration!
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O my Lord! Make Thou my hope to be in Thee, my purpose to be in Thee, my aspiration to be in Thee, my goal to be in Thee, my habitation to be in Thee, my Ka'bih to be in Thee, and the object of my desire to be Thy radiant, mighty and praiseworthy Beauty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that hope, purpose, aspiration, goal, habitation and Ka’bih all be in God and the object of desire His Beauty.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, by the waves of the ocean of Thy oneness from which Thy mention and praise can be heard, to open before the faces of those who seek Thee the gates of meeting with Thee. Then grant them, O my God, the water of life of attaining Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the gates of meeting be opened before those who seek Him and that they receive the water of life of His presence.

selected.text: O Lord! We have turned unto Thy most exalted station and Thy most glorious horizon. I beseech Thee not to disappoint us from that which is with Thee, to grant us Thy presence, and to ordain for us in all circumstances that which will draw us nigh unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh moving from we to I, asking that we be granted His presence and drawn nigh in all circumstances.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Possessor of existence and Lord of the seen and unseen, to make me one of those whom neither the world, nor its might, nor its weapons and artillery have prevented from drawing nigh unto Thee and turning toward the lights of Thy countenance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be among those whom neither the world, its might nor its weapons and artillery prevented from drawing nigh.

selected.text: Thou shouldst strive to abide and persevere in the station of supplication, prayer, entreaty, and utter weakness and tearfully beseech Him, perchance the beaming light of strength radiating from the Sun of Truth may reflect forth from the mirror of thy heart.
selected.reason: Counsel of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to persevere in the station of supplication, entreaty and utter weakness, that the light of the Sun of Truth may reflect from the mirror of the heart; a substantive explanation of prayer’s effect.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by that revelation whereby Moses the Interlocutor was struck down, and by Thy most sweet call which the Beloved was blessed to hear, to ordain for Thy chosen ones that which will shield them from all else save Thee and draw them nigh unto Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by the revelation that struck down Moses, for what will shield His chosen ones and draw them nigh.

selected.text: Glory be to You, O my God! I beseech You by Your Name through which You established Yourself upon the throne of Your Name, the All-Merciful, not to deprive me of the breezes from the paradise of Your reunion and the fragrances from the garden of Your presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be deprived of the breezes of the paradise of reunion and the fragrances of the garden of presence.

selected.text: Send down upon her the breaths of Thy mercy, that she may be carried away wholly from herself, and be drawn entirely towards the seat which, resplendent with the glory of Thy face, sheddeth afar the radiance of Thy sovereignty, and is established as Thy throne.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having given me to drink from the cup of Thy knowledge and adorned me with the ornament of Thy love. I beseech Thee not to withhold from me the pearls of the ocean of Thy utterance, nor the revelations of the Sun of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for the cup of knowledge and the ornament of love, asking not to be withheld from the pearls of the ocean of utterance.

selected.text: My God, my God! Aid me in that which befitteth Thy days and ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto the court of Thy glory and the precincts of Thy holiness. O my Lord! Drive me not from the door of Thy bounty, and deprive me not of the ocean of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for aid befitting God’s days and not to be driven from the door of His bounty.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest me turning toward the lights of Thy countenance and holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of that which Thou hast ordained for those near unto Thee in Thy most exalted Paradise and Thy most sublime Garden.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of one holding fast to the cord of bounty, asking for what is ordained for those near unto God in His Paradise.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that His servants not be driven from His gate and that their faces and hearts be illumined.

selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant and the son of Thy handmaiden. I have turned to Thee, holding fast to the cord of Thy grace and clinging to the hem of Thy loving-kindness. Write down for me that which shall profit me in all the worlds of Thy worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of a servant, son of a servant and of a handmaiden, holding fast to grace and asking for what profits in all worlds.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having guided me unto Thy station and honored me with Thy presence. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty to make me detached from all else save Thee and sanctified from whatsoever is repugnant to Thy good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for guidance and the honor of His presence, with a plea for detachment and purity from whatever is repugnant to God’s good-pleasure.

selected.text: O my Lord! Deprive me not of those outpourings which Thou hast sent down upon Thy sincere ones from the clouds of Thy mercy, and remove me not from the shore of the glory of Thy oneness. Then grant me, O my God, a seat of truth with Thee and join me with Thy sincere servants.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be removed from the shore of oneness, and for a seat of truth among God’s sincere servants.

selected.text: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee … that Thou mayest cause me to be detached from all else save Thee and enable me to attain unto the station wherein I may tear apart the veils that have come between me and the lights of Thy Most Glorious and Most Exalted Countenance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for detachment and a station from which to tear apart the veils between the supplicant and God’s Countenance.

selected.text: My God, my God! By Thy might and Thy majesty, Thy greatness and Thy power! Separation from Thee hath destroyed me and Thy remoteness hath consumed me. Thou seest me, O my God, in the fire of separation and remoteness. Where is the river of Thy presence, O Thou Desire of the world?
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh in the fire of separation asking where the river of God’s presence is.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Name which Thou hast made the King of Names, that Thou cause me to hear the wondrous melodies of Thy praise and make me drink from the Kawthar of Thy knowledge in such wise that I may detach myself from all else but Thee and turn my face toward Thy countenance
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to hear the melodies of God’s praise and drink from the Kawthar of knowledge until detached and turned to His countenance.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which all things have drawn near unto the seat of Thy Command, the Source of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thy signs, to write down for them that which will gladden their hearts and tranquilize their souls through Thy grace and Thy favors.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for others, that what will gladden their hearts and tranquilize their souls be written down for them.

selected.text: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which earthquakes have seized most of the servants, to make me so fixed in my gaze upon Thee in all conditions that nothing may prevent me from that which hath been ordained by the Pen of Thy decree and sent down in the scrolls of Thy glory
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be so fixed in gaze upon God in all conditions that nothing may prevent what His decree has ordained.

selected.text: Thou hearest the sighing of those who, though they long to behold Thy face, are yet separated from Thee and far distant from Thy court. In the morning hours I call upon Thee, hoping for Thy boundless grace, and in the evening I turn to the horizon of Thy mercy, yearning for Thine ancient bounty. I call upon Thee by Thy name, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh telling how the fire of love has driven sleep away, calling on God in the morning and turning to His mercy in the evening; concludes the daily rhythm of remembrance.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be remembered in the Concourse on High as were those who cast away all else.

selected.text: Open Thou outwardly to their faces, O my Lord, the gates of Thy grace, that they may enter them by Thy leave and in conformity with Thy will, and may stand before the throne of Thy majesty, and catch the accents of Thy voice, and be illumined with the splendors of the light of Thy face
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee for having made Thyself known unto me, for having enabled me to turn toward Thee, and for having made clear unto me Thy straight and manifest path. selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh that God made Himself known and made clear His straight path, asking not to be withheld from what is ordained for the chosen ones.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest the poor one drawing nigh unto the ocean of Thy bounty and the sick one unto the Kawthar of Thy healing. I beseech Thee not to disappoint him of that which Thou hast ordained for them that are nigh unto Thee among Thy servants and the sincere ones among Thy creation.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that God sees the poor drawing nigh to the ocean of bounty and the sick to the Kawthar of healing.

selected.text: O Lord! The thirst of separation and remoteness hath consumed me; give me to drink, by the hands of Thy favors, from the Kawthar of nearness and reunion, that the intoxication of the choice wine of Thy mercy may seize me in such wise that I may arise to aid Thy Cause amongst Thy creatures
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to drink from the Kawthar of nearness so that the wine of mercy may move the supplicant to arise and aid the Cause; links longing to action.

selected.text: I call upon Thee, O my God, with my heart, my tongue, my spirit and my soul, and I commune with Thee in the depth of midnight's darkness, while Thou seest tears streaming from mine eyes and my heart burning with the fire of sighs, from the intensity of deprivation and the pain of separation.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá calling on God with heart, tongue and soul in the depth of midnight, with tears and the pain of separation.

selected.text: O my God, my God! selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh recounting that grace, mercy, bounty, love and tenderness have guided and sustained the supplicant; the guide’s fullest statement of grace already received.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what is best in both worlds and to be content with God’s good-pleasure, effaced in His will and steadfast in His love.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest me turning toward the heaven of Thy bounty and awaiting the wonders of Thy generosity. I beseech Thee by the rain-showers of the springtime of Thy mercy to send down upon me that which will purify me from the mention of any save Thee and draw me near to the court of Thy holiness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by the rain-showers of mercy for purification and nearness to the court of holiness.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am the sorrowful one, yet with Thee is the ocean of joy and gladness. I beseech Thee not to withhold me from it … O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy verses … and by Thy Most Exalted Horizon to ordain for me by the Pen of Thy Command that which will comfort mine eyes through Thy grace
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh of the sorrowful one who knows that with God is the ocean of joy, asking for what will comfort the eyes.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the grace which hath encompassed me and all who are in the kingdom of earth and heaven to make me in all conditions turned toward Thee, directing myself to the horizon of Thy bounty, speaking Thy praise and beholding the manifestations of Thy handiwork and the evidences of Thy might.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to be turned toward God in all conditions, speaking His praise and beholding the manifestations of His handiwork and might; widens orientation to the created world.

selected.text: O my God, by Thy Name through which the mountains were moved, the Cry was raised, the heaven was cleft asunder and the earth was rent - to ordain for me a cup from the Kawthar of meeting Thee, a chalice from the Salsabil of attaining unto Thee, and an ocean from the choice wine of nearness unto Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a cup from the Kawthar of meeting, a chalice from the Salsabil of attainment and an ocean of the wine of nearness.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Withhold not from us that which Thou lovest, and deprive us not of that which Thou hast accepted. I beseech Thee by Thy conquering power to make us content with Thy decree and to enable us to hold fast unto the cord of Thy bounty. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh in the plural that God withhold not what He loves and make us content with His decree.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest them turning toward Thee, voicing Thy praise, gazing toward Thy horizon, and clinging to the cord of Thy loving-kindness. I implore Thee to send down upon them that which will draw them closer to Thee in all conditions and cause them to celebrate Thy remembrance at morn and eventide.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for those who turn toward Him, that they be drawn closer and celebrate His remembrance at morn and eventide.

selected.text: O God! Thirsty are we, Thy Grace is the cooling spring! Homeless and shelterless are we. Thy Court is the asylum for poor ones. Indigent are we, give unto us the Treasury of Thy Kingdom. Prisoners are we, free us from ought else save Thee. Nameless and traceless are we, accept us at Thy divine Threshold!
selected.reason: Closing prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá at the Theosophical Society: thirsty, homeless, indigent prisoners asking acceptance at the divine Threshold; the communal form of the guide’s images of need.

selected.text: that Thou mayest send down upon those who have mentioned Thy Most Exalted Name and who have followed the path of Thy love in the realm below, and then raise them up, O my God, unto the stations of holiness in Thy presence, that they may dwell in Thy habitations and drink from the cup of Thy good-pleasure
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that those who followed the path of His love be raised to stations of holiness in His presence.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Disappoint me not from that which is with Thee, and drive me not from Thy door which Thou hast opened before the faces of all who are in Thy earth and Thy heaven. Make me not deprived of the fragrances of Thy Revelation, nor forbidden from drawing nigh unto Thy chosen ones and Thy pure ones.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be driven from the door God has opened before all in earth and heaven, nor forbidden nearness to His chosen ones.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having given me to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the cup of Thy reunion and for having brought me into Thy presence while the opposers lay in wait to prevent Thy servants from turning unto the court of Thy nearness and entering the precincts of Thy companionship
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for having been brought into His presence while opposers lay in wait to prevent the servants.

selected.text: My God and my Beloved! This is Thy servant who hath turned toward the sanctuary of Thy perpetuity, and who hath been set ablaze with the fire of Thy love, and who hath heard Thy call, and who hath detached himself unto Thee, hoping to enter into Thy Kingdom and to ascend unto the heaven of Thy grace and bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a servant set ablaze with love who has heard the call and detached himself, hoping to enter the Kingdom.

selected.text: My God, my God! The fire of Thy love hath set me ablaze and Thy remoteness and separation have destroyed me. Is there a way for me, O my God, to the fortress which Thou hast made a prison for the Manifestation of Thyself? Have I any portion in the hearing of Thy call and beholding the lights of Thy countenance? Have I any share in the waves of the ocean of Thy revelation and in standing before the gate of Thy grandeur
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking whether there is a way to the fortress made a prison for the Manifestation and any portion in hearing His call; keeps the prison setting of its why.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Make my life Thy Name, and my spirit Thy remembrance, and my hope Thy Beauty, and my paradise Thy nearness, and my Kawthar Thy call, and my Ka'bih Thy love, and my sanctuary Thine atmosphere, and my goal the seat of Thy mighty Throne. O Lord! Drive me not from the door of Thy mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh making God’s Name the supplicant’s life, His nearness paradise and His love the Ka’bih, and asking not to be driven from His door.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Make my heart in all conditions to turn toward Thee, and my tongue to make mention of Thee, and my face to be illumined by the lights of Thy countenance, and every limb of my body to incline toward the direction of Thy bounties and the dawning-place of the lights of Thy oneness.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the heart turn, the tongue make mention, the face be illumined and every limb incline toward God; the guide’s image of heart, speech and body oriented together.

selected.text: O my God! Grant me complete severance from all else save Thee, and enlighten the eyes of our hearts with the light of beholding Thee, that the eyes of the heart may burn away the veils of light and attain to the source of grandeur and joy, and that our spirits may become suspended in the glory of Thy holy splendor.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for complete severance and enlightened inner sight, that the heart may burn away the veils of light.

selected.text: My God, my God! Nearness to Thee is my hope, beneath Thy shadow is my purpose, in Thy presence is my aim, before Thee is my desire, meeting Thee is the utmost object of my hope, and attaining Thy presence is my wish. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me through Thy grace and mercy, O Thou Most Merciful of the merciful!
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh declaring nearness, His shadow, His presence and meeting Him to be the supplicant’s hope, purpose, aim and wish.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having given me to drink from the cup of Thy knowledge and for having made known unto me Thy straight path and Thy firm and mighty Command. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Exalted Pen to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Powerful.
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for the cup of knowledge and the straight path, asking by the Most Exalted Pen for what will draw the supplicant nigh.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the signs of Thy Kingdom and the mysteries of Thy Dominion, and by that which the Tongue of Thy Grandeur has spoken forth and appeared through Thy command and sovereignty, to ordain for me that which shall be a light unto my heart, a radiance unto my sight and a strength unto my limbs.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for what will be a light to the heart, a radiance to the sight and a strength to the limbs.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Thou seest my powerlessness, my brokenness, my abasement, my distress, my anxiety and my agitation in my separation from Thy presence and my deprivation in being parted from Thee. I lament as one who thirsts for sweet waters, and I moan as one who is enthralled by the intensity of yearning and passion.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing powerlessness and agitation in separation, lamenting like one who thirsts for sweet waters.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, to send down upon them that which will gladden their hearts and give peace to their beings. Thou knowest that the fire of separation cannot be quenched save by the waters of Thy reunion and presence, and their agitation cannot be stilled except by beholding Thy beauty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for others whose fire of separation can be quenched only by the waters of reunion and presence.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh recalling the sighs and tears of those who long for God in His days, whose hearts have melted in the fire of His love.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the Sun of Thy Revelation and the heaven of Thy grace and the ocean of Thy power, to ordain for me that which shall cause me to endure with the endurance of Thy Kingdom, and to stand in every world of Thy worlds before the throne of Thy grandeur, and to drink the Kawthar of reunion from the hands of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to endure with the endurance of God’s Kingdom and stand before His throne in every world.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having adorned my head with the crown of Thy utterance and illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge. I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy knowledge and the mysteries of Thy Book to open before my face the door of Thy bounty and to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee.
selected.reason: Thanksgiving of Bahá’u’lláh for the crown of utterance and the light of knowledge, asking that the door of bounty be opened before the supplicant’s face.

selected.text: I beg of Thee! O my God! My Lord! My Hope! and my utmost Desire! Verily Thou knowest my humility, my contrition, my poverty, my indigence, my agitation and my longing. selected.reason: Closing prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá at a weekly meeting in Paris, calling on God with a heart overflowing with His love and a soul assured by His commemoration.

selected.text: O Lord of destiny and Sovereign of humanity! I beseech Thee by the Most Great Scene - the station wherein every hidden matter was revealed more swiftly than the twinkling of an eye - to make me one of those who have attained unto the Kawthar of Thy utterance and have drunk the choice wine of steadfastness from the hands of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to drink the choice wine of steadfastness from the hands of God’s bounty.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Perfect Name not to leave me cast down at the seat of self and desire. Then cause me to ascend, through Thy bounty, to the heaven of immortality that I may attain, through Thy grace, to such a station wherein I speak naught except Thy remembrance and move not save through Thy love and good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh not to be left cast down at the seat of self and desire but raised to speak only God’s remembrance and move only through His love.

selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh giving a prayer of one who has longed to appear before His face while days and nights pass without the eyes gladdened.
